_comment: Notifications. Phase 13 — scaffolded per management's instruction. The fourteen trigger rules are real and unit-tested (functions/shared/pure/notification-rules.ts); this table is what they write to for in-app display. Outbound email/SMS delivery needs a mail/SMS provider configured in your Zoho org (env_variables on the cron Function) — not needed for management's initial test build, called out explicitly rather than silently assumed. ScheduledReminders was added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration (apps/web Phase C reports/cron slice) — missing from the original Phase 13 port; it's what apps/web's /api/cron/reminders job reads to turn a due, unsent reminder into a Notifications row.

columns.comment: One of the 14 named triggers — see notification-rules.ts.

Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original port. apps/web's notifications.title (short headline, shown bold) is distinct from the body/message text; the original Phase 13 scope only had a single `message` column, which apps/web's account page and cron reminder job both need split in two.
The body text — mirrors apps/web's notifications.body.

tables.comment: Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 13 port. Ported from apps/web scheduled_reminders. Populated by the CAPA and Documents modules when a due_date/review_date is set (their own Phase C migration slices), consumed by apps/web's /api/cron/reminders job (src/server/cron/process-reminders.ts), which turns each due, unsent row into a Notifications row for the responsible user and then stamps sent_at so a retried cron invocation can't double-notify.

columns.comment: ROWID of the CAPA or DocumentVersions row this reminder is for.
